text:
ITEM 1 | Bright green florets with dark green tips and short pale stems, clustered on the upper-left of the plate; florets roughly 2-3 cm across, firm, slightly glossy with some darker charred-looking speckles, arranged in a loose mound covering about 20% of the plate | 90
ITEM 2 | Pale yellow scrambled egg in soft, irregular curds with some lighter and slightly deeper golden patches, moist-looking and loosely clumped, sitting on the right side of the plate and partly over the broccoli, covering about 25% of the plate at roughly 2 cm average height | 110
ITEM 3 | Flat, dark green spinach leaves with smooth glossy surfaces and visible midribs, some wilted and some whole, spread across the lower-left of the plate in a layer about 0.5 cm thick, covering about 20% of the plate | 60
ITEM 4 | Thin orange shreds of carrot, bright orange with slightly translucent edges, scattered among the spinach at the lower-center | 8
ITEM 5 | Thin pale slices of white radish or similar pale round vegetable with pale green-white edges, a couple of slices near the lower-right beside the spinach, each about 3 cm across and thin, slightly glossy | 10
